items.exampleEn: The station is close to my house.
Sorry, you have the wrong number.
Write your name at the top of the page.
items.exampleZh: 請在這一頁的最上面寫上你的名字。

items.sentenceZh: 我最喜歡的顏色是紅色。

items.audioEn: Please come quickly. The bus is here!
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼要你快一點？

items.sentenceEn: This question is short but difficult.
The bank is close to the station.

items.stemEn: Sorry, this is the ____ bus. I want the number 5 bus.
items.stemZh: 抱歉，我搭錯公車了，我要搭的是 5 號公車。
請走快一點，我們遲到了。

items.passageEn: Jenny has a new red bike. Her school is not close to her home, so she rides her bike every day. She rides quickly. The way to school is not difficult, but there is a big hill at the end. At the top of the hill, she can see the sea.
items.passageZh: Jenny 有一台新的紅色腳踏車。她的學校離家不近，所以她每天騎腳踏車上學。她騎得很快。上學的路不難騎，但最後有一座大山坡。在山坡頂上，她可以看到大海。

questions.questionZh: Jenny 的新腳踏車是什麼顏色？
Jenny 在山坡頂上可以看到什麼？

rubricZh: wrong 放在 be 動詞後面（例如 is wrong）；寫 not right、not correct 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 color 造一個句子，說說你最喜歡的顏色。
referenceEn: I like the color green best.
rubricZh: 「最喜歡的顏色」可寫 my favorite color（英式拼法 favourite colour 也正確）
顏色名稱可放在 be 動詞後面或當主詞（例如 My favorite color is blue、Blue is my favorite color）
寫 I like the color blue best.、Blue is my favorite color. 等也正確
